concepts.title: The Last Ferry Light
concepts.premise: A ferry pilot finds that the lighthouse on the far shore blinks the names of people who have not been born yet, and the owner wants a warmer, less bleak tone.
cast: Ines Moreau: ferry pilot who keeps a logbook of every crossing
Dov Aldren: lighthouse keeper who has not left the island in years
Tilda: Ines's niece, who hums the pattern before she can talk
concepts.setting: A foggy island ferry route and a stone lighthouse
beats: Ines notices the light blinking a pattern that is not on any chart.
She decodes it as names and finds her niece's name already written.
Dov admits that the light only blinks names it intends to protect.
Ines tries to switch the light off and the fog closes around the ferry.
She learns the light is guiding the ferry home, and the last name on the list is hers.
concepts.why_it_works: The decoding puzzle stays, and the ending now rewards the listener instead of punishing the pilot.
concepts.audience: Listeners who like mystery with a human heart.
concepts.series_potential: Each part decodes one more name and shows whom the light is protecting.
